exampleEn: Sometimes, you just have to throw caution to the wind and try something new.
exampleKo: 가끔은 위험을 감수하고 새로운 것을 시도해야 할 때가 있어.
gameExamples: She decided to throw caution to the wind and take that job offer abroad.
In order to achieve her dreams, he had to throw caution to the wind and invest in himself.
During their adventure, they chose to throw caution to the wind and explore the uncharted island.
